preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 100 for x in [int(x) for x in input().split()[1:]])
preconditions.description: All point coordinates are integers between 0 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(set([int(x) for x in input().split()[1:]])) == n
preconditions.description: All n points are distinct (guaranteed by problem statement).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= l <= r <= 100 for line in input().splitlines()[2:] for l, r in [tuple(map(int, line.split()))])
preconditions.description: Each segment [l, r] has integer bounds 0 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ 100.
Input constraints: 1 ≤ n ≤ 100 points and 1 ≤ m ≤ 100 segments.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or all(c in '01' for c in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: Output is either -1 (no solution) or a sequence of n integers (0=red, 1=blue).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(abs(ri - bi) <= 1 for segment in segments for ri, bi in [(sum(1 for x in points if l <= x <= r and color[i] == '0'), sum(1 for x in points if l <= x <= r and color[i] == '1')) for i, x in enumerate(points) for l, r in segments])
postconditions.description: For every segment [l, r], the absolute difference between red points (ri) and blue points (bi) in the segment is ≤ 1, where `points` are the input coordinates, `segments` are the input segments, and `color` is the output sequence (0=red, 1=blue).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout.strip().split()) == n and all(c in '01' for c in stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output exactly n integers (0 or 1) representing the color of each point.
